name: Pork Belly
siboNotes: Plain pork belly is FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Choose fresh cuts without added marinades or seasonings that may contain FODMAPs.
preparationTips: Avoid marinades containing garlic, onion, or high-FODMAP ingredients
Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Cook methods like roasting, braising, or slow cooking work well
Score the skin in a crosshatch pattern for better rendering if keeping skin on
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein for muscle maintenance
Rich in B vitamins, especially B1 and B6
Good source of zinc and selenium
